Despite the fact that, in general, the systems obtain high values, BERT outperforms them again. BERT's F1-score is 1.9 points higher than the next most competitive result in the comparison. More remarkably, the recall obtained by BERT is about 5 points above.

Specifically, we include the results of a domain-independent NLNDE model (S2), and the results of a model enriched with domain-specific embeddings (S3). title: Sensitive Data Detection and Classification in Spanish Clinical Text: Experiments with BERT
answer_short: BERT outperforms other systems in recall and shows high robustness to training-data scarcity, achieving a recall of 0.979 in NUBes-PHI and losing only 7 points of F1-score when trained on 230 instances.
answer_rationale: The performance of BERT is highlighted in multiple sections: in NUBes-PHI, it achieves a remarkably high recall of 0.979, outperforming other systems, and demonstrates robustness to data scarcity by losing only 7 points of F1-score when trained on 230 instances. These results are explicitly stated in Text 1 (source_id=85, 86) and Text 5 (source_id=74, 78).
